snippet.title: Cat Customs Simulator - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Inspect adorable cats at the border! Check passports, verify luggage weight, scan suspicious suitcases, and uncover unallowed items. Spot mismatches, catch smugglers, and decide who gets through customs in this cozy cat inspection simulator.

Wishlist now on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5168460/Cat_Customs_Simulator/
